description: This file contains functions and logic for configuring remote gateway connections in the OpenClaw system, including discovery, URL validation, and authentication setup.

methods.name: buildLabel
methods.description: Builds a label string for a given GatewayBonjourBeacon.

methods.name: ensureWsUrl
methods.description: Ensures the WebSocket URL starts with ws:// or wss://, defaulting if empty.

methods.name: validateGatewayWebSocketUrl
methods.description: Validates that the WebSocket URL starts with ws:// or wss:// and is secure if required.

methods.name: promptRemoteGatewayConfig
methods.description: Main function to interactively prompt user for remote gateway configuration, including discovery, URL, and authentication.
